author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The response identity parameter is a redundant caller-provided mirror of the request argument.
findings.consequence: This adds an extra public argument and branch that looks like stale-response protection, but the function recomputes the same identity from the supplied request; actual stale protection is enforced by direct callers with request ownership/current-identity checks.
findings.evidence: Line 634 compares responseRequestIdentity with textSearchResultsRequestIdentity(request). The inspected direct callers in app/pages/sök.vue compute that identity from the same body passed as request before calling acceptTextSearchResultsResponse, while route freshness is checked separately around those calls.
findings.recommendation: Remove responseRequestIdentity from acceptTextSearchResultsResponse and its callers, or replace it with an actual independently captured expected identity only if this function is meant to own stale-response policy.
verification: Inspected direct callers in app/pages/sök.vue at the primary, navigator snapshot, and show-more call sites.
